label: Ikony · Gangnam Style
desc: Zkřížená zápěstí, jízda na koni s poskoky, točení lasa, cval do strany a zpět.
style_tail: , static camera, cinematic studio lighting, photorealistic, one continuous dance movement at a steady moderate tempo, highly detailed
negative: blurry, low quality, watermark, text, distorted face, extra fingers, bad anatomy, extra limbs

beats.prompt: the dancer stands with knees bent and crosses the wrists in front of the body, hands in loose fists, bouncing lightly, and holds the crossed-wrist pose
the dancer bounces in place as if riding a horse, knees lifting alternately, fists held together in front like holding reins, and ends with both feet down
one arm swings above the head in circles as if twirling a lasso while the other hand holds the reins and the knees keep bouncing, and ends with the arm up
the dancer gallops sideways with small hops to one side and then back, holding the reins, and ends in the starting spot
the dancer stops with feet together, wrists crossed in front again, and holds the pose with a serious face
